msg: I started by choosing a colour set (red and purple was my choice). I stuck with that same colour set until it dropped to 2 mushrooms. As soon as that happened, I concluded that it was time to swap to green and brown.I continued following that same pattern of play during the whole game. I would often keep getting over 8 mushrooms every round for multiple rounds in a row and rarely streaked below 3 mushrooms for any length of time.So for example:Start with Red and Purple If you get 3 or more mushrooms, keep choosing Red and Purple If your mushroom forest "dries up" and you get below 2 or fewer mushrooms, swap to Green and Brown.Continue this pattern of play to win!
